REVENANT_GENERATOR_12 }} A '''Revenant Minion''' is a {{Skill|Combat}} [[Minions|Minion]] that spawns {{MobSprite|Revenant}}s and collects {{Item|Rotten Flesh}} and {{Item|Diamond}}s. '''Revenant Minion''' recipes, except '''Revenant Minion XII''', are unlocked at {{CollectionLink|Zombie Slayer V}}. '''Revenant Minion XII''' recipe is unlocked at {{CollectionLink|Zombie Slayer IX}}. A '''Revenant Minion XII''' also needs {{CollectionLink|Zombie Slayer IX}} to be placed down. Players get one free '''Revenant Minion I''' by reaching {{CollectionLink|Zombie Slayer V}}. == Usage == === Drops === {{Minion Drops Table}} === Stats === {{MinionStatsTable}} === Layouts === ==== Ideal Layout ==== {{Minion ideal layout|minion=Revenant Minion|ideal=Air (minion)|border=Oak Fence}} === Minion Modifiers === {{Minion Modifiers List|combat}} == Obtaining == {{MinionRecipesTable}} == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" !
